plan.title: Paired 3-condition DE: control vs treatment A vs treatment B
plan.analytical_narrative: Four subjects each contribute a control, treated_a, and treated_b blood sample (raw Salmon gene counts, 12000 genes x 12 samples). The design is paired/repeated-measures across three within-subject conditions, so subject is blocked as a fixed covariate in DESeq2 (design ~ subject + condition). Step 1 runs sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap) to confirm subjects/conditions cluster as expected and to catch any subject or condition outlier before modeling. Step 2 filters low-count genes, fits the DESeq2 likelihood-ratio test (full ~subject+condition vs reduced ~subject) to find any gene responding to either treatment within a subject, then extracts pairwise Wald contrasts (treated_a vs control, treated_b vs control, treated_a vs treated_b) with control as the explicit reference level, answering both halves of the research question (response to either treatment, and difference between the two treatments). Step 3 shrinks the pairwise log2 fold changes with ashr (contrasts between two non-reference levels are not single coefficients, so apeglm does not apply to the A vs B contrast) and applies BH-adjusted multiple testing within each contrast at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering. Step 4 takes the significant gene list from each contrast (universe = tested genes) into GO biological-process over-representation via clusterProfiler enrichGO, mapping symbols to Entrez with org.Hs.eg.db, testing up- and down-regulated genes as separate lists, reducing redundant GO terms with rrvgo, and falling back to a caveat about the ranked LRT-statistic gene list if fewer than ~50 genes pass FDR in a contrast (an over-representation test on a very short list has no power). Step 5 assembles the final report with fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), p-value histograms, the reproducibility record, and the overlap/discordance across the three contrasts.

Benjamini-Hochberg within each contrast, alpha=0.05, independent filtering on
fgsea preranked GSEA per contrast on Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark, then Reactome
